bang_ngu_phap.ten: Mệnh đề trạng ngữ (nâng cấp câu)

bang.Từ nối: when · while · as soon as · until · before/after
bang.Ví dụ: **As soon as** the metro opened, congestion fell.
**Since** rents are high, many people commute.

bang.Từ nối: so that · in order to · to + V
bang.Ví dụ: The city built parks **so that** residents could relax.

bang.Từ nối: if · unless · as long as · provided that
bang.Ví dụ: **Provided that** funding continues, the project will finish.
**While** cities offer jobs, they are expensive.

bang.Từ nối: so + adj + that · such + N + that
bang.Ví dụ: Rents are **so high that** young people cannot buy homes.

luot.en: How have cities in your country changed in recent years?

pa.cau: How have cities in your country changed in recent years?
pa.ipa_noi: /haʊ həv ˈsɪtiːz‿ɪn‿jə ˈkʌntri tʃeɪndʒd‿ɪn ˈriːsən‿tʃɪəz/

luot.en: Quite dramatically, I’d say. As the economy has grown, more people have migrated from rural areas, which has led to serious overcrowding. While infrastructure has improved, it hasn’t kept pace with the population, so traffic congestion is now a major problem in most large cities.

pa.cau: Quite dramatically, I’d say. As the economy has grown, more people have migrated from rural areas, which has led to serious overcrowding. While infrastructure has improved, it hasn’t kept pace with the population, so traffic congestion is now a major problem in most large cities.
pa.ipa_noi: /kwaɪt drəˈmætɪkliː aɪ diː seɪ əz ðə ɪˈkɑːnəmiː həz ɡrəʊn mɔː ˈpiːpəl həv ˈmaɪˌɡreɪtɪd frəm ˈrʊrəl ˈeriːəz‿wɪtʃ həz led tə ˈsɪriːəs ˈəʊvəˌkraʊdɪŋ‿waɪl ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə həz ˌɪˈmpruːvd‿ɪt hasn tiː kept peɪs‿wɪð ðə ˌpɑːpjəˈleɪʃən səʊ ˈtræfɪk kənˈdʒestʃən‿ɪz naʊ ə ˈmeɪdʒə ˈprɑːbləm‿ɪn məʊst lɑːdʒ ˈsɪtiːz/

luot.en: What are the advantages of living in a big city?
luot.vi: Sống ở thành phố lớn có lợi gì?

pa.cau: What are the advantages of living in a big city?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt‿ə ðə æˈdvæntɪdʒɪz‿əv ˈlɪvɪŋ‿ɪn‿ə bɪɡ ˈsɪtiː/

luot.en: Opportunity, mainly. There are more jobs, better hospitals and a far wider range of things to do in the evening.
luot.vi: Chủ yếu là cơ hội. Có nhiều việc làm hơn, bệnh viện tốt hơn và nhiều hoạt động buổi tối phong phú hơn hẳn.

pa.cau: Opportunity, mainly. There are more jobs, better hospitals and a far wider range of things to do in the evening.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˌɒpəˈtjuːnəti ˈmeɪnliː ðə ə mɔː dʒɑːbz ˈbetə ˈhɑːˌspɪtəlz‿ən‿ə fɑː ˈwaɪdə reɪndʒ‿əv θɪŋz tə də ɪn ðə ˈiːvnɪŋ/

luot.en: And the disadvantages?
luot.vi: Còn bất lợi thì sao?

pa.cau: And the disadvantages?
pa.ipa_noi: /ən ðə ˌdɪsəˈdvæntɪdʒɪz/

luot.en: Cost and noise, above all. Rent takes up a large share of income, which forces many young people to live far from the centre.
luot.vi: Trên hết là chi phí và tiếng ồn. Tiền thuê nhà chiếm phần lớn thu nhập, buộc nhiều người trẻ phải ở xa trung tâm.

pa.cau: Cost and noise, above all. Rent takes up a large share of income, which forces many young people to live far from the centre.
pa.ipa_noi: /kɑːst‿ən nɔɪz‿əˈbʌv‿ɔːl rent teɪks‿ʌp‿ə lɑːdʒ ʃeə əv ˈɪˌnkʌm‿wɪtʃ ˈfɔːsɪz ˈmeniː jʌŋ ˈpiːpəl tə laɪv fɑː frəm ðə ˈsentə/

luot.en: How could housing be made more affordable?
luot.vi: Làm sao để nhà ở dễ mua hơn?

pa.cau: How could housing be made more affordable?
pa.ipa_noi: /haʊ kəd ˈhaʊzɪŋ biː meɪd mɔː əˈfɔːdəbəl/

luot.en: By building upwards near transport lines. Restricting height keeps supply low, which pushes prices up over time.
luot.vi: Bằng cách xây cao tầng gần các tuyến giao thông. Hạn chế chiều cao khiến nguồn cung thấp, và theo thời gian đẩy giá lên.

pa.cau: By building upwards near transport lines. Restricting height keeps supply low, which pushes prices up over time.
pa.ipa_noi: /baɪ ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈʌpwədz nɪə træˈnspɔːt laɪnz riːˈstrɪktɪŋ haɪt kiːps səˈplaɪ ləʊ wɪtʃ ˈpʊʃəz ˈpraɪsəz‿ʌp ˈəʊvə taɪm/

luot.en: Would you prefer to live in the countryside?
luot.vi: Bạn có thích sống ở nông thôn hơn không?

pa.cau: Would you prefer to live in the countryside?
pa.ipa_noi: /wə‿dʒə prɪˈfɜː tə laɪv‿ɪn ðə ˈkʌntriːˌsaɪd/

luot.en: Perhaps later in life. At the moment my work requires me to be in the city, although I do miss the quiet.
luot.vi: Có lẽ về sau. Hiện tại công việc buộc tôi ở thành phố, dù tôi thực sự nhớ sự yên tĩnh.

pa.cau: Perhaps later in life. At the moment my work requires me to be in the city, although I do miss the quiet.
pa.ipa_noi: /pəˈhæps ˈleɪtə ɪn laɪf‿ət ðə ˈməʊmənt maɪ wɜːk riːˈkwaɪəz miː tə biː ɪn ðə ˈsɪtiː ˌɔːˈlðəʊ aɪ də mɪs ðə ˈkwaɪət/

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại 2 — Quy hoạch và không gian công cộng

luot.en: Are there enough public spaces in your city?
luot.vi: Thành phố bạn có đủ không gian công cộng không?

pa.cau: Are there enough public spaces in your city?
pa.ipa_noi: /ə ðə ɪˈnʌf ˈpʌblɪk ˈspeɪsəz‿ɪn‿jə ˈsɪtiː/

luot.en: Far from it. The parks that exist are crowded, and most new developments include very little green space.
luot.vi: Còn xa mới đủ. Những công viên hiện có thì đông đúc, và phần lớn khu đô thị mới rất ít mảng xanh.

pa.cau: Far from it. The parks that exist are crowded, and most new developments include very little green space.
pa.ipa_noi: /fɑː frəm‿ɪt ðə pɑːks ðət‿ɪˈɡzɪst‿ə ˈkraʊdəd‿ən məʊst nuː dɪˈveləpmənts ˌɪˈnkluːd ˈveriː ˈlɪtəl ɡriːn speɪs/

luot.en: Why do developers avoid building them?
luot.vi: Vì sao chủ đầu tư né việc xây chúng?

pa.cau: Why do developers avoid building them?
pa.ipa_noi: /waɪ də dɪˈveləpəz‿əˈvɔɪd ˈbɪldɪŋ ðem/

luot.en: Because open space generates no direct income. Unless regulations require it, the land is usually sold for apartments.
luot.vi: Vì không gian mở không sinh lợi trực tiếp. Nếu quy định không bắt buộc, đất thường được bán làm căn hộ.

pa.cau: Because open space generates no direct income. Unless regulations require it, the land is usually sold for apartments.
pa.ipa_noi: /bɪˈkɔːz ˈəʊpən speɪs ˈdʒenəˌreɪts nəʊ dəˈrekt ˈɪˌnkʌm‿əˈnles ˌreɡjəˈleɪʃənz rɪˈkwaɪə ɪt ðə lænd‿ɪz ˈjuːʒuəli səʊld fə əˈpɑːtmənts/

luot.en: What do public spaces contribute?
luot.vi: Không gian công cộng mang lại điều gì?

pa.cau: What do public spaces contribute?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt də ˈpʌblɪk ˈspeɪsəz kəˈntrɪbjuːt/

luot.en: They give people somewhere to meet without spending money, which matters a great deal in an expensive city.
luot.vi: Chúng cho người ta chỗ gặp gỡ mà không phải tiêu tiền, điều rất quan trọng ở một thành phố đắt đỏ.

pa.cau: They give people somewhere to meet without spending money, which matters a great deal in an expensive city.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðeɪ ɡɪv ˈpiːpəl ˈsʌˌmweə tə miːt‿wɪˈθaʊt ˈspendɪŋ ˈmʌni wɪtʃ ˈmætəz‿ə ɡreɪt diːl‿ɪn‿ən‿ɪkˈspensɪv ˈsɪtiː/

luot.en: Should old buildings be preserved?
luot.vi: Có nên bảo tồn công trình cũ không?

pa.cau: Should old buildings be preserved?
pa.ipa_noi: /ʃəd‿əʊld ˈbɪldɪŋz biː prəˈzɜːvd/

luot.en: The significant ones, certainly. Preserving everything is impractical, but a city without its history feels anonymous.
luot.vi: Những công trình có ý nghĩa thì chắc chắn nên. Giữ lại tất cả là bất khả thi, nhưng một thành phố không có lịch sử thì vô hồn.

pa.cau: The significant ones, certainly. Preserving everything is impractical, but a city without its history feels anonymous.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðə səˈɡnɪfɪkənt‿wʌnz ˈsɜːtənliː prəˈzɜːvɪŋ ˈevriːˌθɪŋ‿ɪz ˌɪˈmpræktəkəl bət‿ə ˈsɪtiː wɪˈθaʊt‿ɪts ˈhɪstəriː fiːlz‿əˈnɑːnəməs/

luot.en: How can cities balance growth and character?
luot.vi: Làm sao để đô thị cân bằng giữa phát triển và bản sắc?

pa.cau: How can cities balance growth and character?
pa.ipa_noi: /haʊ kən ˈsɪtiːz ˈbæləns ɡrəʊθ‿ən ˈkerɪktə/

luot.en: By concentrating tall buildings in a few districts. That protects the older areas while still allowing the city to grow.
luot.vi: Bằng cách tập trung nhà cao tầng vào vài khu vực. Cách đó bảo vệ khu phố cũ mà thành phố vẫn phát triển được.

pa.cau: By concentrating tall buildings in a few districts. That protects the older areas while still allowing the city to grow.
pa.ipa_noi: /baɪ ˈkɑːnsəˌntreɪtɪŋ tɔːl ˈbɪldɪŋz‿ɪn‿ə fjuː ˈdɪstrɪkts ðət prəˈtekts ðə ˈəʊldə ˈeriːəz‿waɪl stɪl‿əˈlaʊɪŋ ðə ˈsɪtiː tə ɡrəʊ/

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại — Di chuyển đến vùng ngoại ô

luot.en: Do you like living in the city center, Nam?
luot.vi: Nam, bạn có thích sống ở trung tâm thành phố không?

pa.cau: Do you like living in the city center, Nam?
pa.ipa_noi: /də jə laɪk ˈlɪvɪŋ‿ɪn ðə ˈsɪtiː ˈsentə næm/

luot.en: It is too noisy because of traffic congestion.
luot.vi: Ồn ào quá vì kẹt xe liên miên.

pa.cau: It is too noisy because of traffic congestion.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt‿ɪz tuː ˈnɔɪziː bɪˈkɔːz‿əv ˈtræfɪk kənˈdʒestʃən/

luot.en: I agree. Many residents want to leave now.
luot.vi: Tôi đồng ý. Nhiều cư dân giờ đây muốn rời đi.

pa.cau: I agree. Many residents want to leave now.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ əˈɡriː ˈmeniː ˈrezɪdənts‿wɑːnt tə liːv naʊ/

luot.en: Are you looking for a new place, Linh?
luot.vi: Linh, bạn đang tìm chỗ ở mới à?

pa.cau: Are you looking for a new place, Linh?
pa.ipa_noi: /ə jə ˈlʊkɪŋ fə ə nuː pleɪs lɪn/

luot.en: Yes, I am moving to a suburb next month.
luot.vi: Đúng rồi, tháng sau tôi chuyển tới vùng ngoại ô.

pa.cau: Yes, I am moving to a suburb next month.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes‿aɪ əm ˈmuːvɪŋ tə ə ˈsʌbɜːb nekst mʌnθ/

luot.en: Is the infrastructure good in that area?
luot.vi: Cơ sở hạ tầng ở khu đó có tốt không?

pa.cau: Is the infrastructure good in that area?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz ðə ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə ɡʊd‿ɪn ðət ˈeriːə/

luot.en: It has a school and some new facilities.
luot.vi: Ở đó có trường học và vài tiện ích mới.

pa.cau: It has a school and some new facilities.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt həz‿ə skuːl‿ən səm nuː fəˈsɪlətiz/

luot.en: What about your commute to the office?
luot.vi: Còn việc đi làm của bạn thì sao?

pa.cau: What about your commute to the office?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt‿əˈbaʊ‿tʃə kəˈmjuːt tə ðə ˈɒfɪs/

luot.en: Public transport is quite fast there.
luot.vi: Phương tiện công cộng ở đó khá nhanh.

pa.cau: Public transport is quite fast there.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˈpʌblɪk træˈnspɔːt‿ɪz kwaɪt fæst ðeə/

luot.en: Is there any green space for walking?
luot.vi: Có không gian xanh nào để đi dạo không?

pa.cau: Is there any green space for walking?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz ðə ˈeniː ɡriːn speɪs fə ˈwɔːkɪŋ/

luot.en: Yes, there is a big park nearby.
luot.vi: Có, gần đó có một công viên lớn.

pa.cau: Yes, there is a big park nearby.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes ðə ɪz‿ə bɪɡ pɑːk ˈnɪəˈbaɪ/

luot.en: Does the rapid urbanisation change it?
luot.vi: Đô thị hóa nhanh chóng có làm thay đổi nơi đó không?

pa.cau: Does the rapid urbanisation change it?
pa.ipa_noi: /dəz ðə ˈræpəd ˌɜːbənaɪˈzeɪʃn tʃeɪndʒ‿ɪt/

luot.en: I hope it stays quiet and peaceful.
luot.vi: Tôi hy vọng nó vẫn giữ được sự yên tĩnh.

pa.cau: I hope it stays quiet and peaceful.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ həʊp‿ɪt steɪz ˈkwaɪət‿ən ˈpiːsfəl/

luot.en: Is the cost of living cheaper there?
luot.vi: Chi phí sinh hoạt ở đó có rẻ hơn không?

pa.cau: Is the cost of living cheaper there?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz ðə kɑːst‿əv ˈlɪvɪŋ ˈtʃiːpə ðeə/

luot.en: It is much cheaper than the city center.
luot.vi: Nó rẻ hơn nhiều so với trung tâm thành phố.

pa.cau: It is much cheaper than the city center.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt‿ɪz mʌtʃ ˈtʃiːpə ðən ðə ˈsɪtiː ˈsentə/

luot.en: That sounds like a great plan, Linh.
luot.vi: Nghe có vẻ là một kế hoạch tuyệt vời đấy, Linh.

pa.cau: That sounds like a great plan, Linh.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðət saʊndz laɪk‿ə ɡreɪt plæn lɪn/

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại — Tìm nhà ở khu vực mới

luot.en: Hello Mai, are you busy looking for housing?
luot.vi: Chào Mai, bạn đang bận tìm nhà ở à?

pa.cau: Hello Mai, are you busy looking for housing?
pa.ipa_noi: /həˈləʊ maɪ ə jə ˈbɪzi ˈlʊkɪŋ fə ˈhaʊzɪŋ/

luot.en: Yes, I need to find affordable housing today.
luot.vi: Đúng rồi, hôm nay tôi cần tìm nhà ở giá rẻ.

pa.cau: Yes, I need to find affordable housing today.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes‿aɪ niːd tə faɪnd‿əˈfɔːdəbəl ˈhaʊzɪŋ təˈdeɪ/

luot.en: Many high-rise buildings are too expensive now.
luot.vi: Nhiều tòa nhà cao tầng hiện nay đắt quá.

pa.cau: Many high-rise buildings are too expensive now.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˈmeniː haɪ raɪz ˈbɪldɪŋz‿ə tuː ɪkˈspensɪv naʊ/

luot.en: I know, and the overcrowding is getting worse.
luot.vi: Tôi biết, mà tình trạng quá tải đang ngày càng tệ.

pa.cau: I know, and the overcrowding is getting worse.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ nəʊ ən ðə ˈəʊvəˌkraʊdɪŋ‿ɪz ˈɡetɪŋ‿wɜːs/

luot.en: Why do you not move to a rural area?
luot.vi: Tại sao bạn không chuyển về vùng nông thôn?

pa.cau: Why do you not move to a rural area?
pa.ipa_noi: /waɪ də jə nɑːt muːv tə ə ˈrʊrəl ˈeriːə/

luot.en: My job is still in the city center.
luot.vi: Công việc của tôi vẫn ở trung tâm thành phố.

pa.cau: My job is still in the city center.
pa.ipa_noi: /maɪ dʒɒb‿ɪz stɪl‿ɪn ðə ˈsɪtiː ˈsentə/

luot.en: That makes your daily commute very long.
luot.vi: Việc đó làm cho quãng đường đi làm mỗi ngày của bạn rất dài.

pa.cau: That makes your daily commute very long.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðət meɪks‿jə ˈdeɪliː kəˈmjuːt ˈveriː lɔːŋ/

luot.en: I really need a place with better facilities.
luot.vi: Tôi thực sự cần một nơi có cơ sở vật chất tốt hơn.

pa.cau: I really need a place with better facilities.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ ˈrɪliː niːd‿ə pleɪs‿wɪð ˈbetə fəˈsɪlətiz/

luot.en: Have you checked the apartments near the park?
luot.vi: Bạn đã xem các căn hộ gần công viên chưa?

pa.cau: Have you checked the apartments near the park?
pa.ipa_noi: /həv‿jə tʃekt ðə əˈpɑːtmənts nɪə ðə pɑːk/

luot.en: Are there any shops and public transport there?
luot.vi: Ở đó có cửa hàng và phương tiện công cộng không?

pa.cau: Are there any shops and public transport there?
pa.ipa_noi: /ə ðə ˈeniː ʃɑːps‿ən ˈpʌblɪk træˈnspɔːt ðeə/

luot.en: Yes, the city is doing a lot of infrastructure work.
luot.vi: Có, thành phố đang thực hiện nhiều công trình hạ tầng.

pa.cau: Yes, the city is doing a lot of infrastructure work.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes ðə ˈsɪtiː ɪz ˈduːɪŋ‿ə lɑːt‿əv ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə wɜːk/

luot.en: That sounds perfect for my family.
luot.vi: Nghe rất hoàn hảo cho gia đình tôi.

pa.cau: That sounds perfect for my family.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðət saʊndz pəˈfekt fə maɪ ˈfæməli/

luot.en: The cost of living there is still okay.
luot.vi: Chi phí sinh hoạt ở đó vẫn ổn.

pa.cau: The cost of living there is still okay.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðə kɑːst‿əv ˈlɪvɪŋ ðə ɪz stɪl ˌəʊˈkeɪ/

luot.en: I am going to visit the area tomorrow.
luot.vi: Ngày mai tôi sẽ đi thăm khu vực đó.

pa.cau: I am going to visit the area tomorrow.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ əm ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt ðə ˈeriːə təˈmɑːˌrəʊ/

luot.en: I hope you find a nice house there.

doan_van.ten: Đoạn văn mẫu — Thách thức đô thị hóa
doan_van.noi_dung:
In recent decades, rapid urbanisation has transformed major cities around the world into crowded urban centres. Because many people move from rural areas to seek better employment opportunities, the demand for housing and modern facilities has grown dramatically. While this migration boosts the local economy, it also places immense pressure on existing infrastructure. As a result, city planners face numerous complex challenges in managing the growth of urban populations.

One of the most urgent problems in large cities is traffic congestion. Since thousands of workers commute to the city centre every day, main roads become completely blocked during peak hours. Although local governments have expanded public transport systems, overcrowding on buses and trains remains a common complaint among local residents. To solve this problem effectively, city councils must invest heavily in modern transport networks so that citizens can travel conveniently without relying on private vehicles.

Another major issue is the lack of affordable housing in growing metropolitan regions. As the cost of living continues to rise dramatically, many working families cannot afford to live near the city centre where property prices are extremely high. Consequently, real estate construction heavily focuses on luxury high-rise buildings, forcing lower-income residents to relocate to distant outer suburbs. Although living in a quiet suburb offers cheaper accommodation, it often means longer travel times and fewer public facilities. Furthermore, city authorities need to preserve and create more green space within residential zones, as regular access to parks is essential for physical and mental wellbeing. If governments do not balance rapid urban expansion with practical environmental needs, the overall quality of city life will continue to decline steadily.

phat_am:
- **infrastructure** /ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə/ — nhấn âm **đầu**, 4 âm tiết.
- **suburb** /ˈsʌbɜːb/ (danh từ, nhấn đầu) vs **suburban** /səˈbɜːbən/ (tính từ, nhấn âm 2).
- **congestion** /kənˈdʒestʃən/ — nhấn âm 2.
luu_y:
**① so + tính từ + that · such + (a/an) + danh từ + that:**
✅ It is **so expensive that** I can’t buy it.
✅ It is **such an expensive city that** I can’t live there.
❌ It is so expensive city that…

**② “so that” (mục đích) khác “so” (kết quả):**

- *They built a metro **so that** people could travel faster.* (để mà)
- *Rents rose, **so** many people moved out.* (nên)

**③ in order to / to + V nguyên thể** cho mục đích cùng chủ ngữ; **so that + mệnh đề** khi khác chủ ngữ:
✅ The city built parks **to improve** air quality. (cùng chủ ngữ)
✅ The city built parks **so that residents could** relax. (khác chủ ngữ)

**④ Tránh lặp “There is/are” mở đầu mọi câu.** Band 5 hay viết cả đoạn toàn “There are many problems…”. Nâng cấp bằng:
*Many problems **arise** from… · The city **faces** several challenges…*

**⑤ Từ dễ nhầm:** **city** (thành phố) / **town** (thị trấn) / **urban area** (khu vực đô thị); **live in** the suburbs nhưng **live on** a street.

**⑥ Speaking Part 3 cần trả lời DÀI hơn Part 1** — tối thiểu 4–5 câu, có lập luận và ví dụ.
meo:
- **so + adj · such + noun.** Nhớ: “such” dài hơn “so” nên đi với cụm dài hơn (có danh từ).
- **so that = “để mà” · so = “nên”.** Dịch thẳng.
- Nâng cấp câu: thay “There are many…” bằng động từ mạnh — **face, arise, suffer from, result in**. Đây là khác biệt giữa band 5 và band 6.

mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Đô thị hóa và nhà ở
mini_story.truyen: Urbanisation poses significant challenges for modern residents living in crowded cities. Firstly, rapid urbanisation often leads to severe congestion and inadequate infrastructure because public transport cannot keep pace with the population growth. Secondly, the lack of affordable housing forces many individuals to live in cramped high-rise buildings far from essential facilities. Consequently, the quality of life declines as people spend hours on their daily commute. Many families now choose to relocate to a quiet suburb to escape the noise. They eventually trade their city apartments for spacious homes with green space in a peaceful rural area. This shift marks a permanent change in their lifestyle as they seek a lower cost of living away from the city centre.

The transition from a stressful urban lifestyle to a peaceful suburban routine brings him true happiness.

While he initially worries about the distance, he discovers that the public transport system is highly efficient. The travel time remains manageable despite the change in location.
